description: This Java source file defines the JournalEntryCommand class, which is an immutable command object used for creating journal entries in an accounting system. It includes validation logic for its fields and aggregates associated debit and credit entries.

classes.name: JournalEntryCommand
classes.description: Immutable command for adding an accounting journal entry with validation logic for fields.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the fields of the command object before creating a new journal entry, throws exception if validation fails.

methods.name: validateSingleDebitOrCredit
methods.description: Validates individual debit or credit entry commands within the journal entry.
